purpose: Versioned trace from a WERK citizen-decision artifact through legal/legislative handling, implementation evidence and impact measurement without equating a platform decision with enacted law or scoring political actors.
invariants: A WERK platform decision is not represented as enacted law or an official referendum result.
Every transition is evidence-bound and append-only/auditable.
A deviation, delay or different formal outcome is recorded descriptively with source/reason code; no politician/party score or motive inference is generated.
Legal/competence uncertainty remains explicit and can block progression.
Implementation evidence is separated from stated intention.
Impact measurement links to the existing WERK impact-measurement system; no duplicate KPI engine.
open_governance_questions: Which WERK decisions are advisory versus internally binding on WERK representatives?
What formal act or evidence qualifies each institutional transition?
Who may enter/countercheck external parliamentary/legal references?
How are changes in law/competence handled without rewriting historical decision records?

integration.input: future WERK VOTE or other separately approved citizen-decision artifact
integration.website: future transparency projection in existing V71; no parallel page
